score_mapping.p_methods: A-D stored raw score=-p; use -log10(max(p,float64.tiny)); invalid p outside [0,1] declines
score_mapping.center: H0 reference median after registered fit screen
score_mapping.scale_validity: first strictly positive finite candidate; otherwise reference unusable and every evaluation of member declines
score_mapping.panel: max of member (transformed score-center)/scale; no clipping, no CDF, no jitter
score_mapping.intrinsic_limits: A retains B=999 permutation p resolution; floating-point p<=tiny are clamped and counted separately

protocol.budget_event: alarm OR member decline conditional on H0 passing finite training log-space R2 >=0.99
protocol.threshold_rule: smallest finite observed calibration score with (strict exceedances+declines)/screened_N <=budget; no test outcome used; infeasible if declines alone exceed floor(budget*N)
protocol.calibration_design: 20 mutually independent H0 reference/calibration pairs per stratum on fixed13 H0 tasks; H1 only generated for test; a single fresh independent test bank is shared across rounds and policies
protocol.point_estimator: equal mean of round-specific ratios; primary aggregate undefined unless all20 policy rounds are feasible and ratio defined; feasible/defined-only sensitivity labelled separately

uncertainty.round_sensitivity: sample SD(ddof=1), min/max and empirical linear2.5/97.5 percentile RANGE across fitted calibration rounds conditional on fixed test bank; range is not a confidence interval
uncertainty.conditional_task: stratified paired test-task bootstrap keeping13 H0/19 H1 task counts; all20 fitted calibration policies fixed
uncertainty.round_only: bootstrap20 rounds with replacement and fixed original test-task weights, interval for empirical mean
uncertainty.crossed: one shared bootstrap round-index vector and one shared H0/H1-stratified test-task weight vector per draw; same vectors across all policies and rounds; average within-round ratios
uncertainty.scope: Conditional on fixed H0 calibration task identities, empirical calibration-round bank and realized shared test samples. Does not refit/calibrate unseen H0 equation sets, include record-level test resampling, or establish unseen-equation generalization.

protocol.outcome: legacy upper endpoint from v1: first feature3*observed training max; others training log medians; unknown outcomes retained operationally and excluded only from labelled-risk denominator
protocol.preservation: Keep every v1 file byte-for-byte; write all v2 artifacts to runs/p01_v2; verify all v1 recursive hashes and new seed/data-hash disjointness
protocol.stop_rule: One frozen grid. No tuning or stopping based on new test results. Statistical changes require a new protocol and fresh streams.
